description: This file defines extension methods for configuring state storage-based log consistency providers within the Orleans hosting framework. It provides methods to add default and custom state storage providers to the silo builder, facilitating dependency injection and service configuration.

classes.name: StateStorageSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to add state storage log consistency providers.

methods.name: AddStateStorageBasedLogConsistencyProviderAsDefault
methods.description: Adds a default state storage log consistency provider to the silo builder.

methods.name: AddStateStorageBasedLogConsistencyProvider
methods.description: Adds a custom state storage log consistency provider with a specified name to the silo builder.

methods.name: AddStateStorageBasedLogConsistencyProvider
methods.description: Internal method that registers the state storage log consistency provider services into the dependency injection container.
